top.screen2Hint: Show the confidence monitor fullscreen on the second screen
top.touchHint: Touch mode: bigger buttons for touchscreens

rundown.title: Rundown
rundown.autoHint: Auto-next: when this cue reaches zero, the next cue starts immediately by itself (no button press). Leave off to wait for the operator.
rundown.startHint: Start time (e.g. 14:00). Set it and the cue starts by itself at that time. Leave empty to follow the previous cue (shown faintly).
rundown.endHint: End time. Typing an end time sets the duration from the start time.
rundown.clockDurationHint: Until-time cues run from their start until the end time
rundown.needStart: Set a start time on this cue (or an earlier one) first, so the duration can be worked out
rundown.empty: No cues yet. Add one, or import a list from Excel / Google Sheets.
rundown.dragHint: Drag to reorder · double-click to load
rundown.load: Load into the timer (ready, not started)
rundown.targetHint: Time of day to count down to (24 h, e.g. 19:00)
rundown.confirmImport: Importing a show file replaces the rundown, messages, theme and settings. Continue?
rundown.notePlaceholder: Note for the operator, e.g. Break · coffee until 10:30
rundown.flashOvertime: Flash the time on screens when this cue runs over (fades in and out)
rundown.startDeltaHint: How early (green) or late (red) this cue really started compared to the plan
rundown.endDeltaHint: How much shorter (green) or longer (red) this cue really ran than planned

shows.title: Saved shows
shows.none: No saved shows yet. Type a name above and click Save as.
shows.confirmDiscard: The current show has unsaved changes. Continue anyway?
shows.confirmDelete: Delete the saved show "{name}"? This removes the file.
shows.hint: Shows are saved as files in the app's "shows" folder, so you can back them up or copy them to another computer. Saving keeps the rundown, quick messages and broadcast look; computer settings stay as they are.

broadcast.onAir: ON AIR — click to take off
broadcast.offAir: Off air — click to go live
broadcast.label: Label
broadcast.highlight: Colour part of the time with the accent colour
broadcast.hideZeroMinutes: Under one minute show only seconds (animates out)
broadcast.hoursHint: Hours appear only when needed and animate away when they reach zero.
broadcast.obsHint: Add a Browser Source (OBS) or Web Browser input (vMix) at 1920×1080 with this URL. The background is transparent.
broadcast.urlOptions: Options: add ?bg=chroma for a green background, ?always=1 to ignore On Air, ?layout=corner to force a layout.

outputs.modeMainText: {name} runs the timer. Other laptops running Lupixis Timer can connect to it from their Outputs tab.
outputs.modeRemoteText: Following the timer on {name} ({url}). The floating window and outputs on this laptop show that timer, and the controls and hotkeys here control it.
outputs.noneFound: Searching… No other Lupixis Timer found yet. You can also type an IP address below.
outputs.disconnect: Disconnect and use this computer's own timer
outputs.floatingHint: A small always-on-top window you can place over PowerPoint's presenter view. Drag to move, drag the edges to resize.
outputs.screensHint: Open a view fullscreen on a connected monitor, projector or LED processor. Press Esc on that screen to close it.
outputs.takeover: When a second screen is connected, fill it with
outputs.takeoverHint: Saved on this computer. Also applies when the app starts, like a dedicated timer box.
outputs.browserOnly: The floating window and fullscreen outputs are available in the desktop app. You can still open any view below in a browser.
outputs.linksHint: Any phone, tablet or computer on the same network can open these.

settings.translateHint: Translations live in public/locales. Copy en.json to add a new language.
settings.idleDisplay: When no timer is running, show
settings.floatingControls: Control buttons (−1m, start/pause, +1m, next, minimise, close)
settings.controlsHover: Show when the mouse is over the window
settings.autoStart: Start cues automatically at their start time
settings.hotkeysHint: Work even while PowerPoint is in front. Click a field and press the key combination. Backspace clears it.
settings.hotkeyRecord: Click, then press a key combination
settings.hotkeyNeedsModifier: Use Ctrl, Alt or Shift with the key (or an F-key)
settings.hotkeyTaken: Could not register: another app is using this combination
settings.keepOnTop: Keep floating timer above fullscreen apps

clips.title: Clip timers (QLab / CasparCG)
clips.hint: While a tracked video or audio clip plays, speakers see a small pop-up with its name and time left.
clips.passcode: OSC passcode (if the workspace has one)
clips.byTag: have this text in name or notes
clips.casparHint: In casparcg.config add this computer's IP and this port under osc → predefined-clients.
clips.casparTag: have this text in the file name

csv.title: Import from spreadsheet
csv.hint: Paste rows copied from Excel or Google Sheets, or CSV. Columns: Title, Duration, Speaker. A header row with names like Title, Speaker, Duration, Start, Notes is also understood.
